reason: The README describes a Typert remote adapter that exposes writing-project data and search to a client panel while triggering host-side synchronization and project scaffolding workflows.

summaries.zh: 为写作客户端面板提供项目、书库和检索数据，并触发主机侧的同步与项目初始化流程。
summaries.en: Provides a remote data channel for a writing panel to access project and library content, search data, and host-side synchronization or project initialization workflows.

capabilities: Reads project, chapter, lore, library, evolution, and narrative-thread data through a host-side remote interface
Performs project and library full-text search
Triggers host-side chapter-end orchestration through syncNow
Initializes an empty project structure through scaffoldNow
